**Organization Name.** The Gojira Ancestral Defense Branch (aka the self-proclaimed true Gojira Clan)

**Leader.** Asahito first-Gojira

**Organization Type.** Clan

**Years in existence.** ~900

**Goals.** Defending the world from the threat of historical Kaiju threats

**Creed.** "*The world needs its protectors. We are them: now, and forever.*"

**Impact.** Moderate

The Gojira Ancestral Defense Branch are a seminomadic, historical detachment of the original Gojira clan that live in the barren wastes east of Neon City—a detachment that has managed to survive until the modern day.

When many Kaijuborn began to participate in the reconstruction of society alongside their more traditionally humanoid peers, the Ancestral Defense Branch split away from the Gojira clan. Charging themselves with tending to their historic duty of the defense of the world and its people against the ever-looming Kaiju threat—and armed with conviction, extensive military training, and a penchant for survival in a strange, extreme world—the branch splintered off and headed southeast, traveling across the world and subjugating Kaiju in their wake.

Over centuries of inconsistent contact with other Kaijuborn clans—and proliferating in spite of their insanely dangerous goals—they found themselves becoming enveloped in their own traditions. The Ancestral Defense Branch of today are deeply ritualistic and highly efficient hunters, a society that prizes none above the other, save for their strength in the face of the Kaiju threat. They are ferocious in battle and are heavily lacking in the politesse and *education* that one would expect from a city dweller.

Having reestablished contact with Neon City for over a century now, they are not ignorant of modern technology. Their aid was instrumental in the protection of and set up of network extensions from the city to the far outskirts. As a result, their hunt has been enhanced by the presence and power of modern tech. Nonetheless, the old ways still prevail: to lay low a Kaiju is no easy feat, and no one is better prepared than the Ancestral Defense Branch.

As a result of their staunch commitment to what they now consider to be their sacred, immutable duty, the Gojira clan have laid stake to the claim that they are the true branch of the Gojira clan. This puts them at odds with the Gojira clan that resides in Neon City, and while there is tension between them, it has never come to a head. Members of each clan treat each other with begrudging respect, though claims of lineage and rank are usually looked upon with some disdain from one to the other.
